Default selected finding does not includ.detail: Default request carries scope 'selection', findings 'all', occurrences 'cited', crops/pageRenders enabled, annotations/filename/sourcePdf all off. Spec leg 1 deselects one finding and asserts the downloaded bundle contains neither the deselected finding nor its occurrences nor unrelated text; legs 2-3 assert no source bytes, filename, or notes appear unless explicitly opted in. Review F1 regression leg proves a deselection survives note-driven source rebuilds.

full-source warning requires explicit ch.detail: The 'Include original PDF' checkbox is off by default; checking it surfaces the source-warning disclosure ('The original PDF is included verbatim...'). With no source attached the control is disabled and the state reports requested_source_missing. When enabled the engine verifies actual bytes against the recorded document sha256 and fails closed on mismatch (spec leg 3).

crop is described as excerpt not safe re.detail: Crop preview renders the real projected excerpt image plus the mandated disclosure 'excerpt — not a redaction; the full page text remains in the report' (spec leg 4 asserts both the decoded PNG bytes and the disclosure).

selected omissions retain honest origina.detail: Spec leg 1 asserts produced_occurrence_count stays 118 and check coverage stays complete after deselection, with omissions disclosed count-level in the payload and named ids via projection notices ('deselected-findings' manifest line). Review F2 added a note-level line when notes ride out with deselected findings.
